identity.mission: Create a trustworthy, organic, and modern accommodation finder that feels like a hospitality brand, not a cold database.
principles: Content: Story-driven listings, not just data points
Zoom: Focus on texture and details (linens, sunlight)
Negative Space: Generous breathing room for trust

theme.strategy: Organic & Earthy (Trust/Growth) with a Tech Twist

headings.usage: Main headers, section titles. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

usage_rules: Primary (Deep Moss): Brand identity, headers, active states.
Accent (Sunset Orange): Primary CTAs (Book Now, Search). Use sparingly.
Background (Warm White): Main canvas. Avoid pure #FFFFFF for backgrounds, use #FAFAF9.
Text: Never pure black. Use #1C1917 (Warm Black) or #78716C (Stone Grey).

spacing.scale: Tailwind default but shifted up (p-4 -> p-6)

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-primary rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-secondary/80 transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-primary/5 transition-all

cards.listing: bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 group
cards.feature: bg-muted/50 p-8 rounded-2xl border border-transparent hover:border-border transition-all

inputs.search: h-14 pl-12 rounded-full border-transparent bg-white shadow-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 text-lg placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70

landing_hero.type: Split or Centered with Floating Search
landing_hero.structure: Large emotional image + Floating Search Bar (Glassmorphism) + Trust Badges

listing_grid.rules: Mix of col-span-1 and col-span-2 cards. Don't make everything uniform.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar Navigation + Dense Data Grid. Use white cards on muted background.

hero.desc: Happy students taking selfie - Hero Main
Modern building exterior with lawn - Hero Background

icons.usage: Use consistent sizing (w-5 h-5 for UI, w-8 h-8 for features).

setup: Install fonts: Manrope and Space Grotesk via Google Fonts or Fontsource.
Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette (Deep Moss, Sunset Orange, Warm White).
Override Shadcn CSS variables in index.css to match the 'Organic & Earthy' theme.
implementation_rules: DO NOT use generic blue (#3B82F6) anywhere.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings. Use 'Inter' for body.
Ensure all cards have a subtle border and hover lift.
Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. Do not use random picsum images.
For the Search Bar: Make it prominent, pill-shaped, and floating with a shadow.
For Dashboards: Keep it clean. Use white cards on the #FAFAF9 background.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
